CREATE TABLE truss.row_home_node (state_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES truss.row_home_state (state_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, node_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('truss.row_home_id_seq'), parent_node_id bigint, slot_kind text NOT NULL COLLATE pg_catalog."C", sequence_ordinal bigint, map_key text COLLATE pg_catalog."C", record_field_identity_bytes bytea, value_kind text NOT NULL COLLATE pg_catalog."C", definition_bytes bytea NOT NULL, source_bytes bytea NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT row_home_node_pk PRIMARY KEY (state_id, node_id), CONSTRAINT row_home_node_id_unique UNIQUE (node_id), CONSTRAINT row_home_node_positive_ids CHECK (state_id > 0 AND node_id > 0 AND (parent_node_id IS NULL OR parent_node_id > 0)), CONSTRAINT row_home_node_parent_fk FOREIGN KEY (state_id, parent_node_id) REFERENCES truss.row_home_node (state_id, node_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT row_home_node_not_self_parent CHECK (parent_node_id IS DISTINCT FROM node_id), CONSTRAINT row_home_node_value_kind CHECK (value_kind IN ('scalar', 'null', 'sequence', 'map', 'record', 'structured')), CONSTRAINT row_home_node_slot CHECK ((slot_kind = 'root' AND parent_node_id IS NULL AND sequence_ordinal IS NULL AND map_key IS NULL AND record_field_identity_bytes IS NULL) OR (slot_kind = 'sequence' AND parent_node_id IS NOT NULL AND sequence_ordinal >= 0 AND sequence_ordinal IS NOT NULL AND map_key IS NULL AND record_field_identity_bytes IS NULL) OR (slot_kind = 'map' AND parent_node_id IS NOT NULL AND map_key IS NOT NULL AND sequence_ordinal IS NULL AND record_field_identity_bytes IS NULL) OR (slot_kind = 'record' AND parent_node_id IS NOT NULL AND record_field_identity_bytes IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(record_field_identity_bytes) > 0 AND sequence_ordinal IS NULL AND map_key IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT row_home_node_carriers_nonempty CHECK (octet_length(definition_bytes) > 0 AND octet_length(source_bytes) > 0))
ALTER TABLE truss.row_home_state ADD CONSTRAINT row_home_state_root_fk FOREIGN KEY (state_id, root_node_id) REFERENCES truss.row_home_node (state_id, node_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX row_home_one_root ON truss.row_home_node USING btree (state_id) WHERE parent_node_id IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX row_home_sequence_slot ON truss.row_home_node USING btree (state_id, parent_node_id, sequence_ordinal) WHERE slot_kind = 'sequence'

CREATE TABLE truss.row_home_touch (transaction_id xid8 NOT NULL DEFAULT pg_catalog.pg_current_xact_id(), owner_kind text NOT NULL COLLATE pg_catalog."C", owner_id bigint NOT NULL, owner_discriminator_id int NOT NULL, property_owner_type_id int NOT NULL, property_id int NOT NULL, dirty_generation bigint NOT NULL, sealed_generation bigint, original_layout_bytes bytea NOT NULL, original_home_bytes bytea NOT NULL, original_owner_property_bytes bytea NOT NULL, original_operation_bytes bytea NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT row_home_touch_pk PRIMARY KEY (transaction_id, owner_kind, owner_id, owner_discriminator_id, property_owner_type_id, property_id), CONSTRAINT row_home_touch_kind CHECK (owner_kind IN ('object', 'edge')), CONSTRAINT row_home_touch_generations CHECK (dirty_generation > 0 AND (sealed_generation IS NULL OR (sealed_generation > 0 AND sealed_generation <= dirty_generation))), CONSTRAINT row_home_touch_originals CHECK (octet_length(original_layout_bytes) > 0 AND octet_length(original_home_bytes) > 0 AND octet_length(original_owner_property_bytes) > 0 AND octet_length(original_operation_bytes) > 0))
